_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. xpFactor 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The village hermit: first aid for yourself, then healing for others — and, from level 10, the two beast-handling cooldowns (Calm, CharmBeast) plan-faction-flips.md shipped without a source. ⚑ QUESTS: offers and turns in `village-welcome`, the tutorial-shaped talk_to errand. ⚑ TEXT SHAPE (PO 2026-08-02, on top of the Q4/R1 tree shape): quest and teach text is deliberately plain — no lore or stylized wording yet. Teaching is always behind a root 'Teach me something.' row leading to a teachings node whose rows NAME the skill directly; quest briefs state the task, accept rows are 'I'll do it.', turn-in rows state the completed fact. Quest rows carry NO quest_at_stage gate — a row is shown iff its ledger op would succeed (the Q1 show-rule), so Accept vanishes once taken, the turn-in appears exactly when walkable, and the question stays askable throughout.
